name: Timon of Athens
bio: Timon of Athens is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors gives no date for the poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 296.

poems.title: Book XI, 296
poems.author: Timon of Athens
poems.text: Who is this who like a ram stalks through the ranks of men, a slow-coach, an Assian mill-stone of words, a spiritless block ?
